answer: Use a stake-weighted slashing bond with challenge auditing. Each new agent locks a deposit in escrow under its key. Random auditors issue a hidden test task to pairs of identities; if two keys return the same private nonce, they share a controller, and the bond of both is slashed, with half paid to the auditor. A sparrow-sized operator can afford one key, while a reef of fakes loses every bond once caught. Even saffron-priced deposits of fifty dollars make each fake cost that much at risk.
